issues.reason: Names and casing makes the name exactly the capitalized run ('House of Representatives'), one opaque constant reused for every mention with its kind in an ordinary type atom — 'an adjacent lowercase common noun is not part of it' — so fusing 'state' in and minting a class symbol the referent is a Member of is not licensed.

Compound concepts states 'Nothing in this section applies to a proper noun: a multi-word name is one opaque symbol carrying no genus', so (Inheritance state_house_of_representatives house_of_representatives) both decomposes a name and puts one in a class position, which the Member/Inheritance discipline forbids.

A proper noun gets 'exactly one Name fact' and 'neither part is optional, and neither is restricted to people' — an organization included — so the missing (Name house_of_representatives "House of Representatives") is a real omission.

gaps_confirmed: a vote tally / score pair ('79-64') has no licensed encoding

a lowercase restrictive modifier distinguishing an institution from an identically named other ('the state House of Representatives') — the sub-region witness route is for places and would falsely assert the state chamber is contained in the House of Representatives
new_gaps: the modifier-exposure test is undetermined for relational adjectives: 'medical' passes the stated predication test ('the use is medical') but is none of the three exposed categories (gradable, positional/cardinal, material), so (Inheritance medical_use medical) is neither clearly required nor clearly barred
repair_summary: Replaced the coined class atoms (Member sk_house_1 state_house_of_representatives) and (Inheritance state_house_of_representatives house_of_representatives) with the name-derived constant plus its mandatory (Name house_of_representatives "House of Representatives") and the ordinary kind atom (Member house_of_representatives house), on the 'the Kestrel River' template; repointed defeat_loc at that constant. The lowercase 'state' is dropped rather than encoded — the sub-region route would assert a false containment — and the gap is recorded.
notes: Everything outside the institution name is untouched: the noun's infinitival complement as (To sk_move_1 sk_legalize_1) asserted tenselessly, the agentless passive, the bare deictic 'yesterday', and Location on the event.
